title: Design System: Empi Proof Bench (Publisher and Launcher)

mask-black.displayName: Mask Black (alpha mask only, never painted)

pink.displayName: Electric Pink (Publisher accent; launcher default accent)

launcher-ink.displayName: Launcher Ink (label on accent, text on paper)

launcher-danger.displayName: Launcher Danger (DETENER, login errors; legibility exception)

display.purpose: Publisher selected pack title. Never body text.

drawer-title.purpose: Activity drawer title and launcher version numerals.

wordmark.purpose: Uppercase Empi Publisher in the topbar.

headline.purpose: Section h2 in Segoe UI Variable.

body.purpose: Publisher: everything read or edited; prose capped at 62ch.

code.purpose: Logs, paths, command preview in Cascadia Mono.

launcher-title-30.purpose: Welcome header, login options heading, settings nav header.

launcher-title-20.purpose: Version rail title. 20px is the smallest size Doto appears at in the launcher.

launcher-launch-label.purpose: The launch button label, the one Doto exception below 20px.

launcher-label.purpose: 13px labels: progress label, player name, updater title. Avenir is the launcher's existing body face and stays.

launcher-help.purpose: 11px floor for help text and progress stats.

launcher-chip.purpose: 10px floor for chips and small labels.

shadows.name: drawer-cast
shadows.purpose: The only shadow (Publisher): separates the slid-in activity drawer. The launcher has none.

shadows.name: input-underline
shadows.purpose: Publisher input focus: a 3px accent line at the bottom edge, not a glow.

motion.name: publisher-doctrine
motion.value: alive but budgeted
motion.purpose: The Publisher moves at rest within a budget; every movement says where you are, what changed or what to do next. Switch: Vivo / Tranquilo, localStorage empi.motion, data-motion on root; reduced-motion starts calm.

motion.name: publisher-fps-focused
motion.value: 24 fps (41 ms frame gap)
motion.purpose: Canvas dot ground while the window has focus.

motion.name: publisher-fps-unfocused
motion.value: 10 fps (100 ms frame gap); 0 when the tab is hidden
motion.purpose: Canvas dot ground without focus; cancelled on visibilitychange hidden.

motion.name: publisher-canvas-density
motion.value: 1 canvas pixel per CSS pixel; 45-degree hex lattice, pitch 24px
motion.purpose: Keeps raster cost flat on dense screens.

motion.name: publisher-degrade
motion.value: smoothed frame cost > 9 ms for 90 frames, or frames > 2.2x late for 45 frames: pitch +6px up to 36px, then calm
motion.purpose: Frame-cost and delivered-frame-rate degradation; the field thins out and finally stops.

motion.name: publisher-measured
motion.value: about 7-10% of one core alive, about 0% calm; canvas frame cost about 1 ms (headless Edge, software raster)
motion.purpose: Measured budget, not a guarantee on other hardware.

motion.name: publisher-animated-properties
motion.value: transform and opacity only
motion.purpose: Arrivals, springs, hover physics, pops, beats. The pre-existing tear and the arrival reveal also use clip-path (see drift).

motion.name: publisher-infinite-allowed
motion.value: skeleton pulse 1.4s steps(2) and running-job LED 1s steps(1) only
motion.purpose: All other Publisher CSS animations are finite or replayed on a timer (beat every 10 s, ambient glitch every 6-14 s, both only when focused and alive).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.value: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)
motion.purpose: Spring-like movement: drawer slide .5s, dialog pop .38s, toast rise .42s, ink slide .5s, card lean .4s, button lift .35s, arrivals .6s.

motion.name: ease
motion.value: cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .2, 1)
motion.purpose: Colour and background transitions (.12s to .15s).

motion.name: ink
motion.value: 4px strip of accent dots; transform and width .5s ease-out
motion.purpose: Slides under the current tab or sub-tab: where you are.

motion.name: arrivals
motion.value: rise-in .6s ease-out, delay calc(var(--i) * 45ms); topbar drop .6s, pipeline lift .7s
motion.purpose: Staggered entrance on load and on pack or tab change.

motion.name: pipeline-motion
motion.value: pop-mark .55s on change; beat 1.6s x2 on the current step; march .9s x4 on finished connectors
motion.purpose: What changed and what to do next.

motion.name: hover-physics
motion.value: pack card translateX(4px); button translateY(-1px) then scale(.97) on press; choice translateY(-2px); primary leans up to 6x4px toward the pointer and a 100deg highlight sweeps .8s
motion.purpose: Things answer the hand.

motion.name: dot-field-cues
motion.value: pointer push, click ripples (1.3s), hover halo on the hovered control, pink glow around the next action, faster while a job runs, ring through the field when a job finishes
motion.purpose: Ground responds to the person and to work.

motion.name: tear
motion.value: 260ms steps(1, end) 1; keyframes 0/15/30/45/60/80/100% translateX -3,4,-2,2,-1px with clip-path bands and text-shadow 2px red/cyan split
motion.purpose: Event glitch, both surfaces: new step, failure, pack title after selecting (Publisher); a view opening, launch button state change, updater state change, update notice (launcher).

motion.name: split
motion.value: 200ms (Publisher) / 260ms (launcher) steps(1, end) 1; text-shadow 2px/-2px/1px red and cyan only
motion.purpose: Hover flash on buttons.

motion.name: led
motion.value: 1s steps(1, end) infinite; opacity 1 to .2 at 50%
motion.purpose: 10px accent square spinner, only while a Publisher task runs.

motion.name: resolve
motion.value: radial-gradient dots on 12px pitch, dot radius = --p x 3.6px, --p 0..1
motion.purpose: Dot-progress strip in the Publisher drawer. Static raster.

motion.name: launcher-doctrine
motion.value: event-only
motion.purpose: The launcher does not move at rest. Nothing loops, no canvas, no blur, no banner breath.

motion.name: launcher-tear-triggers
motion.value: a view opens (welcome, login, login options, waiting, landing, settings title); launch button data-state changes; launcher-update indicator data-state changes; update-ready notice becomes visible
motion.purpose: Only real state changes fire empi-tear, via MutationObservers with no polling; class removed after 400 ms.

motion.name: launcher-pause
motion.value: skipped under html[data-empi-inactive]; plates hidden and tears off under html[data-empi-performance-mode]; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Respects the launcher's RAM-saving mode and pause-on-blur.

motion.name: launcher-progress
motion.value: accent dots rise in #launch_button_fill (6px pitch) while updating or launching
motion.purpose: The launch button is the progress meter; real progress, not decoration.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Publisher: single column, plates hidden, pipeline compact, sidebar becomes a horizontal strip. Launcher: static halftone plates hidden.

tokens.name: dotted
tokens.purpose: Publisher dotted rule for topbar, subtabs, pipeline, dividers. The launcher uses 1px dotted borders in rgb(241 239 232 / .4) and .2.

tokens.name: pipeline-h
tokens.value: 84px (set at runtime from the measured footer height)
tokens.purpose: Reserves bottom space and positions the toast.

tokens.name: topbar-fill
tokens.purpose: Translucent so the living ground shows; no blur.

tokens.name: plate-mask
tokens.value: mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, #000 35%, transparent 100%), linear-gradient(to right, #000 60%, transparent 100%)
tokens.purpose: Feathers the halftone plates on both surfaces. #000 is an alpha mask stop (opaque), never a painted colour.

tokens.name: plates
tokens.value: art/field.png 340px (bottom-left) and 320x118 rotated 180deg (top-right); Publisher: no-JS fallback only, hidden when data-motion is set; launcher: shown on views without artwork, hidden at 900px and in performance mode

tokens.name: launcher-accent
tokens.value: --empi-accent (per version, default #ff3d8b), --empi-accent-rgb, --empi-accent-contrast (#050506 or #ffffff by WCAG contrast ratio)
tokens.purpose: The one colour of the launcher, set by landing.js from the modpack's accent.

tokens.name: launcher-screens
tokens.value: images/identity/screen-bottom.png (640x360, repeat-x, bottom-left) and screen-right.png (300x640, repeat-y, right)
tokens.purpose: Black halftone dot screens over each modpack's untouched background and banner, darkening the edges where the interface is read.

tokens.name: launcher-notch
tokens.value: clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 18px) 0, 100% 18px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); removed on focus-visible

tokens.name: stipple
tokens.purpose: Disabled and locked (.16 on required-mod toggles), both surfaces.

assets.name: art
assets.purpose: Procedural halftone rasters from tools/publisher/scripts/make-art.js; provenance in PNG tEXt chunks. field.png is only the no-JS fallback.

assets.name: Doto
assets.purpose: Added web font of each surface.

assets.name: Avenir
assets.purpose: The launcher's existing body face; stays.

components.name: Primary Button (Compilar)
components.description: Publisher: the one pink action, the next pipeline step. Notched top-right; notch removed on focus. Lifts on hover.

narrative.overview:
A darkroom bench where a modpack is framed, developed and printed. Ground is near-black, marks are paper-white, and tone is made of halftone dots rather than gradients or shadows. Glitch (a 260 ms scan-line tear with a red/cyan channel split) is how the world speaks about change and failure, and one accent colour is reserved for the next thing the person should do. Text and controls stay crisp and legible; the dithering, ribbing and glitch belong to the ground and to events, never to the words you work in.

The mood is precise, printed and slightly uncanny: dot-matrix headlines over a plain UI face, square corners, dotted rules where other systems draw solid lines, and halftone dots as the only imagery the system itself supplies. Both surfaces spend motion by doctrine, and the doctrines differ. The Publisher is alive but budgeted: a canvas of dots breathes behind the work at 24 fps focused, and every movement must say something (where you are, what changed, what to do next). The launcher is event-only: nothing moves at rest, one short tear marks a real state change. Low RAM and CPU stay a product principle in both.
keyCharacteristics: Black and paper-white plus exactly one accent. Publisher: pink. Launcher: the modpack's own accent, pink when a pack sets none. The accent means "next action" or "focus".
Dotted rules divide sections, tabs, bars and panels instead of solid hairlines.
Square corners everywhere; the primary action is notched at one corner, not rounded.
Doto dot-matrix for identity and large headings; a plain UI face for everything read or edited.
Selection is inversion: a paper block, with crop marks on the selected pack or version.
Disabled and locked are ordered stipple, never a faded fill.
Publisher motion is alive at rest but budgeted; launcher motion is a tear when something happens.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks the next action and focus, nothing else. A second accent element competing on screen means one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Flash-Only Channels Rule
rules.body: Red and cyan appear only as short split flashes (260 ms tear, 200 ms Publisher hover split, 260 ms launcher hover split). They are never persistent.

rules.name: The Status Exception Rule
rules.body: Status colours are the only persistent colours outside black, white and the accent, and only for status. Do not extend them to decoration or emphasis.

rules.name: The Paper Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on a paper block is #050506 or #0b0b0d for the main line and #47473f for the sub-line; never paper-2 or paper-3, which fail on paper.

rules.name: The Dots Are Headlines Rule
rules.body: Doto is for wordmark, headlines, the drawer title, version numerals and the launch label. It is never body text, labels, buttons (other than the launch label), or inputs, and in the launcher never below 20px.

rules.name: The Small-Type Floor Rule
rules.body: Launcher text is never below 10px (chips and labels) or 11px (help text and progress). Do not shrink further to fit.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Counts, sizes, versions and progress use tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule
rules.body: No hard offset shadows, glows or blurred card shadows. The drawer cast is the only shadow. The pink glow around the next action lives in the dot field (dots swell and turn pink), not in a box-shadow.

rules.name: The Ribbed Glass Exception
rules.body: The Publisher topbar's repeating-linear-gradient of fine vertical paper lines is a deliberate part of the world (ribbed glass from the moodboard). It is an intentional advisory exception: do not remove it, and do not spread it beyond the topbar.

rules.name: The Budgeted Life Rule
rules.body: The Publisher may move at rest only within its budget (24 fps focused, 10 unfocused, paused hidden, one canvas pixel per CSS pixel, transform and opacity only). Backdrop blur, WebGL, video and animated CSS filters stay out.

rules.name: The Says-Something Rule
rules.body: A Publisher movement that does not tell you where you are, what changed or what to do next is removed.

rules.name: The Calm Fallback Rule
rules.body: Every alive movement has a calm equivalent: the same information with no motion, reached by the switch, reduced-motion, or automatic degradation.

dos: Do spend the accent only on the next action, the focus ring, the current tab underline, the dashed current-step marker, the running LED and the logo dot (Publisher); on the launch button, focus ring and switched-on toggles (launcher).
Do invert to paper (#f1efe8 on #0b0b0d) for selection and secondary emphasis, with #47473f for the sub-line.
Do divide with dotted rules instead of solid hairlines.

Do make every Publisher movement say where you are, what changed or what to do next, animate only transform and opacity, and stay inside the budget (24 fps focused, 10 unfocused, paused hidden, one canvas pixel per CSS pixel).
Do keep the visible Vivo / Tranquilo switch, the empi.motion persistence and the reduced-motion calm start.
Do fire the tear only on events, and use the split text-shadow only for hover.
